title: PoppySessionAssertion
description: Decoded PAP 0.2 session JWT claims, not a token or proof of authentication. Verify signature, issuer audience, expiry, a lifetime of at most 300 seconds and per-client replay prevention before accepting it.

sub.description: Opaque User ID scoped to the Company issuer, never derived from personal information.

aud.description: Exact auth.issuer as a single string. The token endpoint URL and arrays are invalid.

jti.description: Unique assertion ID generated with at least 128 random bits; reject reuse by the same client until expiry.
